name: yolt
description: Deterministic pre-execution guard, not a second opinion on everything: it carries only the decisions deliberately refused to a probabilistic classifier, and delegates the rest to Claude Code auto mode. Decomposes compound commands, heredocs and command substitutions with tree-sitter, analyzes inline Python by AST, refuses writes that steer the agent, denies pushes that rewrite shared history, flags credentials on the command line, and redacts them from its own logs.
